posts.title: Building a Slack agent with AWS
posts.description: Introduction Slack agents are massively powerful. A well-made Slack agent can be used by a company to automate a lot of toil and tiring work. You might ask why a Slack agent is uniquely powerful compared to, say, Claude Desktop.
